title: Teaching a Chemistry MOOC with a Virtual Laboratory: Lessons Learned from an Introductory Physical Chemistry Course
reason: Short course report on a Coursera physical-chemistry MOOC with a virtual lab: enrolment demographics, completion and video-viewing percentages and survey responses, all descriptive. No per-learner indicator is statistically related to success or a trait.
